title: DÉCLARATION 2025 PERSONNES PHYSIQUES - Une aide pratique pour remplir votre déclaration
why_needed: Official guide for completing the 2025 individual return (cantonal, communal and federal).
notes: Cover label GUIDE; file guide-pp-2025_1.pdf, about 60 pages. Web page: https://www.ge.ch/document/guide-fiscal-2025-particuliers

title: Guide fiscal 2025 pour les particuliers
why_needed: Landing page for the 2025 guide; links the PDF and an online guide on getax.ch.
notes: Last updated 2026-04-28. Online guide linked (not opened): https://www.getax.ch/support/guide/declaration2025/

title: Principales déductions pour la déclaration 2025 (chapitre du guide)
why_needed: Summary of the main deductions for the 2025 return, with detailed chapters.
notes: No separate file. Summary page about p. 11 of the guide PDF above. Deduction caps were not extracted.

title: Télécharger et installer GeTax pour les particuliers
why_needed: Official desktop return software for tax year 2025, the main form channel.
notes: Page last updated 2026-01-13. Installers linked (not opened): getax.ch/getaxpp/2025/getax2025.exe (Windows), getax2025.dmg (macOS), getax2025.tar.gz (Linux, needs Java 8 or later).

title: La déclaration en ligne des particuliers
why_needed: Online return via e-démarches, with no software to install.
notes: Pre-filled only if last year's return was sent electronically. Page last updated 2026-01-15.

title: Déclaration pour le prélèvement de l'impôt à la source
publisher: Service de l'impôt à la source, AFC Genève
why_needed: Source-taxed employees declare their family and income situation to the employer for 2025 withholding.
notes: Given to the employer, not the tax office. Form code 24.00.00-1552A. Page: https://www.ge.ch/document/formulaire-declaration-prelevement-impot-source-2025 . English PDF: https://www.ge.ch/document/37885/annexe/file/371411 (not opened). No filing deadline stated; changes must be reported within 14 days.

title: Demande de rectification ou taxation ordinaire ultérieure
why_needed: DRIS and TOU deadline and procedure for source-taxed persons.
notes: Page last updated 2026-03-13. DRIS/TOU form due by 31 March of the year after withholding (31 March 2026 for 2025 withholding, inferred). Filed online via e-démarches, or on paper if received by post. Irrevocability not stated.

title: Barèmes 2026 impôt à la source
why_needed: Source-tax withholding tables in force for 2026.
notes: Contains tables A, B, C and H. Footer dated November 2025; page updated 2026-02-09. Page: https://www.ge.ch/document/baremes-2026-perception-impot-source

title: Barèmes 2025 pour les impôts sur le revenu et la fortune avec exemples de calcul
why_needed: Cantonal and communal income and wealth tax tables for 2025.
notes: Base tables with examples; surcharges come from the communal centimes files. Federal tax not included. HTML page: https://www.ge.ch/document/baremes-icc-impots-revenu-fortune-avec-exemples-calcul-2025

title: Centimes additionnels communaux (CA) et part privilégiée (PP)
why_needed: Communal centimes additionnels for 2025, needed to compute communal tax.
notes: One PDF covers 2020 to 2025, including 2025. Page: https://www.ge.ch/document/centimes-additionnels-communaux-part-privilegiee . No 2026 file on that page.

title: Arrêté approuvant le nombre des centimes additionnels à percevoir pour l'année 2026 par les communes du canton de Genève (ArCA-2026)
why_needed: Legal basis for communal centimes in 2026.
notes: rsGE D 3 05.30, adopted 18 March 2026, in force 1 January 2026. The 2025 arrêté (ArCA-2025) is no longer at this URL and was not checked separately. The page shows a later Vernier entry dated 19.08.2026.

title: Loi de procédure fiscale (LPFisc)
why_needed: Filing obligation, return deadline (art. 27), electronic filing basis (art. 29A) and appeal time limits.
notes: rsGE D 3 17, adopted 4 October 2001, last amended 1 January 2026. Art. 27: at least 30 days from delivery of the form, with extensions under al. 2. Art. 49: 30 days to appeal.

title: Loi sur l'imposition des personnes physiques (LIPP)
why_needed: Substantive rules for individuals, including joint taxation of spouses (art. 8, 41, 66) and the calendar-year tax period (art. 61).
notes: rsGE D 3 08, adopted 27 September 2009, in force 1 January 2010, last amended 1 January 2026. Contains no electronic filing provision.

title: Règlement relatif aux déclarations d'impôt établies à l'aide d'outils informatiques (RDIOI), D 3 17.03
publisher: Administration fiscale cantonale (AFC), Genève (hosted on getax.ch)
why_needed: Implementing rules for software-produced returns, barcodes, approved software and internet transmission (basis: LPFisc art. 29A).
notes: Adopted 26 September 2006, in force 5 October 2006; date shown is the latest amendment. The brief cited D 3 17.07, which was not found. The silgeneve.ch copy of D 3 17.03 was not checked.

title: GeTax - Homologation
why_needed: Official list of approved third-party software for individuals.
notes: Lists DrTax (years 2006 to 2024), WindFisc (to 2021) and Pebe Impots (2006 to 2009). No 2025 entry is shown. Queries: hotline@getax.ch.

title: Le retour des déclarations par internet
why_needed: Explains the two accepted electronic routes (GeTax upload and e-démarches deposit) and when a signed summary page is needed.
notes: Page last updated 2025-01-16; tax year not stated. Printed barcode returns no longer accepted since 2020, except departure or death declarations.

title: Gérer mes déclarations d'impôt
why_needed: Shows how to log in to e-démarches and reach Mon espace fiscal to file online.
notes: Login at https://www.ge.ch/connexion. Authentication method not stated. Zero-paper filing only if all supporting documents are uploaded as PDF.

title: Comment remplir ma déclaration d'impôt
why_needed: Entry hub for the filling, sending and extension sub-pages for individuals.
notes: Deadline 31 March unless an exception applies. A paper form can be obtained by phone or at the Hôtel des Finances.

title: Demander un délai pour ma déclaration d'impôt
why_needed: Extension rules, fees and cut-off dates for requesting more time to file.
notes: Initial deadline 31 March. Requests from 1 January to 31 October online, by phone or by post; from 1 November to 31 December by post only. Fees of CHF 20, 40 or 60 by length of extension. Page does not give 2025 dates.

title: Taux et données fiscales
why_needed: Exchange rates at 31.12.2025 for wealth tax, plus links to communal centimes and interest-rate pages.
notes: Section 'Devises courantes pour l'année fiscale 2025' has the 31.12 rates. The federal Kursliste 2025 PDF linked there is on ictax.admin.ch, outside the ge.ch scope, so it is not listed. Page updated 2026-05-27.

title: Règlement d'application de l'article 29A de la loi de procédure fiscale (RPFisc-29A), rsGE D 3 17.07
publisher: Conseil d'Etat, République et canton de Genève
why_needed: Only official or AFC-approved software may be used for non-paper returns; defines simplified vs strong identification filing
notes: In force 6 March 2024. Verified in the main session; the GE agent did not find it.

title: Déclarez vos titres avec le e-relevé fiscal
why_needed: GeTax imports banks' electronic tax statements (eCH-0196); no direct bank-to-AFC transmission
notes: Verified in the main session.

title: Déclaration fiscale 2025 manuscrite (spécimen)
why_needed: The official 2025 declaration form itself: every page (PG1 to PG4, annexes A1 to G2), every rubric code and its printed French label. Source of the form map behind the copy panel (SPEC.md 10.5) and of the rubric codes of the récapitulation (PG2 to PG4: 14.00, 16.00, 16.70, 55.00, 56.20), the état des titres (F1 to F4), C2 (16.40), C3 (52.11, 56.30) and E1 (55.10).
notes: 26 pages, marked SPECIMEN (not for filing). Page n of the PDF is one form page: 1 PG1, 2 PG2, 3 PG3, 4 PG4, 5 A1, 6 A2, 7 B1, 8 B2, 9 B3, 10 B4, 11 C1, 12 C2, 13 C3, 14 C4, 15 D1, 16 D2, 17 D3, 18 D4, 19 E1, 20 E2, 21 F1, 22 F2, 23 F3, 24 F4, 25 G1, 26 G2. The guide (ge-2025-guide-declaration-pp p. 9) links it as www.ge.ch/c/imp-spde25, a short link that no longer resolves. Landing page: ge-2025-documents-envoyes-page.

title: Déclaration d'impôt 2025: les documents envoyés
why_needed: Landing page of the 2025 declaration specimen, the identifiers page and the main deductions flyer.
notes: Says the specimen must never be used to file, and that 93% of taxpayers use software and only receive the identifiers page.

title: Barèmes 2026 de perception de l'impôt à la source au format ASCII (tar26GE.zip)
why_needed: Machine-readable source-tax tables A, B, C and H for 2026, read by scripts/source-tax-tables.mjs into data/ge/2026/source-tax.
notes: ZIP with tar26ge.txt in the ESTV record format (ch-na-is-recordformat-salaires): monthly incomes, rates in hundredths of a percent, only codes ending in N (Geneva publishes no church-tax variant). Page: https://www.ge.ch/document/baremes-2026-perception-impot-source-au-format-ascii . The readable tables are ge-2026-source-tariff-pdf.

title: Barèmes 2025 de perception de l'impôt à la source au format ASCII (tar25GE.zip)
why_needed: Machine-readable source-tax tables A, B, C and H for 2025, read by scripts/source-tax-tables.mjs into data/ge/2025/source-tax.
notes: ZIP with tar25ge.txt in the ESTV record format. Page: https://www.ge.ch/document/baremes-2025-perception-impot-source-au-format-ascii . The readable tables are ge-2025-source-tariff-pdf.

title: Barèmes 2025 impôt à la source
why_needed: Readable 2025 source-tax tables, to check the values read from the ASCII file.
notes: Page: https://www.ge.ch/document/baremes-2025-perception-impot-source . Annexes on that page (not listed here): barème G and barèmes A1 to A5.

title: Directives concernant l'impôt à la source 2026
why_needed: How Geneva computes source tax (annual model, ch. 2 and 4) and the TOU rules for 2026: compulsory cases, request, deadline and irrevocability (ch. 8.2).
notes: 65 pages, PDF dated 9 February 2026. Page: https://www.ge.ch/document/directives-concernant-imposition-source-2026 (its summary still says valid from 1 January 2025; the PDF itself is the 2026 edition).

title: Directives concernant l'impôt à la source 2025
why_needed: The 2025 edition of the source-tax directives, for the 2025 tables.
notes: Page: https://www.ge.ch/document/directives-concernant-imposition-source-2025

title: Loi sur l'imposition à la source des personnes physiques et morales (LISP), rsGE D 3 20
why_needed: Cantonal source-tax law: compulsory TOU (art. 4) and TOU on request (art. 5), deadline 31 March, applies until the end of source taxation.
notes: Adopted 16 January 2020, in force 1 January 2021, last amended 1 January 2026. The page is windows-1252 encoded.

title: Règlement d'application de la loi sur l'imposition à la source des personnes physiques et morales (RISP), rsGE D 3 20.01
why_needed: Tariff groups (art. 1), compulsory TOU threshold for residents (art. 7) and TOU on request: 31 March deadline, cannot be withdrawn (art. 8 al. 1).
notes: Adopted 30 September 2020, in force 1 January 2021, last amended 1 January 2024. The page is windows-1252 encoded.

title: Quand demander ou annoncer une Taxation Ordinaire Ultérieure?
why_needed: When TOU is compulsory or on request for residents, which deductions it allows, and that it then applies every following year.
notes: Sub-page of ge-2025-dris-tou-page, last updated 13 March 2026. Lists one compulsory case (spouse without activity) that ge-2026-source-directives p. 51 does not: see ge/NOTES.md.

title: Loi générale sur les contributions publiques (LCP), rsGE D 3 05
why_needed: Communal tax: centimes additionnels on the cantonal base tax and the split between the commune of residence (part privilégiée) and the communes of work (art. 293 to 299, art. 295A); the taxe personnelle (art. 374 to 377).
notes: rsGE D 3 05, adopted 9 November 1887, consolidated text with modifications up to 1 January 2026. Art. 295A al. 2: the privileged share (20% to 80%) of each cantonal tax on income and wealth goes to the commune of residence, the rest to the communes concerned in proportion to the income and wealth attributable to each. Art. 375: taxe personnelle of 25 francs; art. 377: exemptions.

title: Communiqué hebdomadaire du Conseil d'Etat du 15 octobre 2025: Fixation de la part privilégiée de chaque commune pour 2026
publisher: Chancellerie d'Etat, République et canton de Genève
why_needed: The privileged share (part privilégiée) of each of the 45 communes for tax year 2026, needed to split the communal tax between the commune of residence and the commune of work.
notes: 21-page weekly communiqué; the table is on p. 11 (Fixation de la part privilégiée de chaque commune pour 2026). The AFC table ge-2025-communal-centimes-pdf stops at 2025. The Conseil d'Etat fixes the share for the next year each October (the 2027 shares are in the communiqué of 7 October 2026).

title: Guide déclaration 2025 Indépendants, impôt cantonal et communal (ICC), impôt fédéral direct (IFD)
why_needed: The guide for the self-employed the main guide refers to (ge-2025-guide-declaration-pp p. 23): annexe B code by code (B1 to B4), the accounts or simple records to attach, the AVS/AI/APG contributions of the self-employed (32.10, 32.11), pillar 3a without a pension fund (32.40), losses of the seven previous years (57.20), the business wealth and its deduction (12.50, 57.50, 51.60).
notes: 36 pages, file guide-independants-2025.pdf. Landing page: https://www.ge.ch/document/guide-fiscal-2025-independants (published 8 September 2026). PDF page n is printed page n. Annexe B: p. 10 to 24; documents to attach: p. 25; the simplified declaration: p. 26 to 28. Added by the self-employment agent on 14 October 2026.

title: Loi relative à la diminution de l'impôt sur le revenu des personnes physiques (LDIRPP), rsGE D 3 06
why_needed: The 12% reduction of the cantonal income tax (art. 1: the direct tax on the income of individuals, except the communal centimes, is reduced by 12%), which also applies to the separate tax on pension capital (LIPP art. 45).
notes: Adopted 26 September 1999 (popular initiative IN 111), in force 16 October 1999, no amendment (Modification: néant). Art. 2 phases the 12% in three steps, the last from 1 January 2005 at the latest. The 2025 tariff (ge-2025-icc-tariff-pdf p. 2 and 4) refers to it as the loi du 26 septembre 1999. The page is windows-1252 encoded.

title: Loi sur les centimes additionnels cantonaux (LCACant), rsGE D 3 07
why_needed: The cantonal centimes on every cantonal tax on the income and wealth of individuals (art. 2: 47.5 centimes, plus 1 centime for home care), the separate tax on pension capital (LIPP art. 45) included.
notes: Adopted 13 September 2019, in force 9 November 2019, no amendment (Modification: néant). Applies LCP art. 289. The page is windows-1252 encoded.

title: Barème 2025 ICC de l'impôt à la source sur les prestations de prévoyance en capital (art. 45 LIPP, 10 et 11 LISP)
why_needed: The official rates of the cantonal and communal tax on pension capital at a fifth of the LIPP scale (art. 45), for a single person without splitting, centimes included: used to check the engine's separate capital tax for 2025 (base tax, 47.5% cantonal centimes, 12% reduction, 1% home care, communal centimes).
notes: 4 pages, footer 'Barème LPP 2025, Part ICC, décembre 2024'. The rates include the cantonal centimes (48.5%: 47.5% and 1% home care) and a flat average of the communal centimes (43.69%), as LISP art. 11 and 12 ask for people living abroad; residents are taxed with their own commune's centimes. The federal part is a separate tariff. Page: https://www.ge.ch/document/bareme-icc-impot-source-prestations-capital-2025

title: Barème 2026 ICC de l'impôt à la source sur les prestations de prévoyance en capital (art. 45 LIPP, 10 et 11 LISP)
why_needed: The official 2026 rates of the cantonal and communal tax on pension capital at a fifth of the LIPP scale (art. 45), centimes included: used to check the engine's separate capital tax for 2026.
notes: 4 pages, footer 'Barème LPP 2026, Part ICC, novembre 2025'. The rates include the cantonal centimes (48.5%) and a flat average of the communal centimes (43.44%). Page: https://www.ge.ch/document/bareme-icc-impot-source-prestations-capital-2026

title: L'impôt des propriétaires immobiliers: le revenu immobilier (impôt sur le revenu)
why_needed: The page the guide sends to for the rental value of property abroad (ge-2025-guide-declaration-pp p. 33, 'Le revenu immobilier'): a home in France (the taxe d'habitation's 'Base d'imposition (valeur locative brute)', or the 'Base' of the 'Commune' column of the taxes foncières times 2), a country with a rental value like Switzerland's (its value, with the country's attestation), a country without one (4.5 % of the tax value, a net flat amount, no upkeep costs), and a property let abroad (the rents received, with a management account, compte de gestion).
notes: Sections 'Votre bien est situé dans le canton de Genève', 'dans un autre canton', 'à l'étranger' (France, a country with an equivalent of the Swiss rental value, a country without one), each with 'Si vous occupez votre bien immobilier, qu'il est à votre disposition ou à celles de vos proches' and 'Si vous louez votre bien'. Last updated 27 April 2026. Added 14 October 2026 by the property abroad agent.

title: L'impôt des propriétaires immobiliers: la valeur fiscale (impôt sur la fortune)
why_needed: The wealth value of property abroad: the tax value set by the country, with its attestation, or, where the country sets none, the purchase price, with a copy of the deed (acte d'acquisition); a value in a foreign currency converted into francs on 31 December of the tax year. A foreign value that is extremely low is replaced by a Geneva-style estimate.
notes: Section 'Votre bien est situé à l'étranger'. Last updated 27 April 2026. Added 14 October 2026 by the property abroad agent.

title: L'impôt des propriétaires immobiliers: les charges et frais déductibles
why_needed: What the owner of a property may deduct for its upkeep, ICC and IFD: the flat deduction (forfait) or the actual costs (frais effectifs), the costs that count (upkeep, PPE charges, building insurance, the impôt immobilier complémentaire, management of a property let), the year of the invoice, and that the invoices are kept, not attached.
notes: Its 'déduction forfaitaire' paragraph gives 10 % and 20 % for the ICC and the IFD alike, while the law (ge-na-law-lipp art. 34 let. d), the guide (ge-2025-guide-declaration-pp p. 33) and the AFC's information 1/2021 (ge-na-information-1-2021-frais-entretien p. 4) give 15 % and 25 % of the rental value for the ICC of one's own home: Taxpresso follows the law (see ge/NOTES.md). Links the information 1/2021 and its notice. Added 14 October 2026 by the property agent.

title: Information N° 1/2021: Déductibilité des frais d'entretien des immeubles privés
why_needed: The AFC's rules on the upkeep costs of private property for the ICC and the IFD (LIFD art. 32, LIPP art. 34 let. d and e): the actual costs that count (upkeep, the PPE renovation fund, running costs, insurance, management, energy-saving investments, demolition), the flat deduction and its table (ICC 15 % or 25 % of the rental value after the abattement and limited to the taux d'effort; IFD 10 % or 20 % of the gross rental value or rents), the choice made for each property, each year and each tax, the costs that never count, the invoice date, and the carry-forward of energy-saving and demolition costs.
notes: 6 pages. Landing page https://www.ge.ch/document/information-fiscale-1/2021-deductibilite-frais-entretien-immeubles-prives. The table of p. 4 carries a note 'Nouvelle disposition à partir de la période fiscale 2024' (LIPP art. 34 let. d from 2024). Applies from tax period 2020. Added 14 October 2026 by the property agent.

title: L'impôt des propriétaires immobiliers: l'impôt immobilier complémentaire
why_needed: The yearly tax on property in Geneva (impôt immobilier complémentaire, LCP art. 76 to 79) for individuals: 1 per mille of the tax value, 0.2 per mille for one's main home, without the 4 % abattement and without deducting debts, due by the owner on 31 December; the 20-year exemption of buildings with a high energy performance standard (HPE, THPE, LCP art. 78).
notes: Sections 'Vous êtes un particulier', 'Vous êtes une entreprise, une association ou une fondation', 'Obtenir une exonération'. ge.ch answered with a maintenance page on some tries on 14 October 2026: check that the saved file is the page. Added 14 October 2026 by the property agent.

title: Loi sur les estimations fiscales de certains immeubles (LEFI), rsGE D 3 10
why_needed: Why the tax value of a villa or a flat in PPE comes from the AFC and not from a calculation: the estimates are extended without limit (art. 1), raised by 12 % for the first tax period after 1 January 2025 (art. 2 al. 1) with exceptions (art. 4); the yearly indexation of art. 2 al. 2 was annulled by the Federal Supreme Court (9C_606/2024) and is now set by the RIVFI.
notes: Adopted 4 November 2022, in force 1 January 2025; art. 2 al. 2 annulled (arrêt TF 9C_606/2024, 28 February 2025). Added 14 October 2026 by the property agent.

title: Règlement fixant l'indexation de la valeur fiscale de certains immeubles (RIVFI), rsGE D 3 10.03
why_needed: From tax period 2026, the tax value of villas and PPE flats is indexed each year by a coefficient built from federal and cantonal price indices (art. 3 to 7): the value for the year is the AFC's, as its letter gives it, never computed by Taxpresso.
notes: In force 1 January 2026. Added 14 October 2026 by the property agent.
